maria_g: hey team - putting together a compact 'stress holdpoints' checklist for new-model bringup and quantization runs. goal: short, deterministic gates we can run fast in CI and then expand for canary. draft below, please react with :thumbsup: or call out gaps.

maria_g: REQUIRED ARTIFACTS BEFORE ANY CANARY
- model artifact (sha + quant config)
- baseline eval DB id + seed set id
- canonical prompt-suite (<=500 examples for smoke, 5k for regression)
- cost/latency perf target for target hardware (p50/p95)
- owner + rollback contact

maria_g: SMOKE / QUICK CHECKS (run in ~10–30m)
- smoke harness: run `eval-harness --suite smoke --model <candidate>` (10 categories x 5 examples each)
- quantization smoke: run `quant-smoke --checks kv-cache --tokens 512`
- basic correctness: exact-match/pass-rate on deterministic tasks >= baseline - 3% absolute
- perf: median latency <= target * 1.2, token cost estimate within 15% of baseline
- safety: run `safety-lite` policy; zero critical failures allowed
- annotate outputs for 5 manually inspected examples

maria_g: PASS/FAIL RULES (SMOKE)
- any critical safety or reproducibility failure -> FAIL
- avg semantic-match (human proxy metric) drops > 6% vs baseline -> FAIL
- latency blowup > 40% -> HOLD (needs infra triage)

maria_g: EXTENDED REGRESSION (overnight/CI)
- run full eval-harness (all suites) against baseline; compute per-suite delta and aggregate QA score
- compute A/B winrate on sampling tasks (n=1000 pairs)
- acceptance: weighted QA score >= baseline_score - 0.02 (absolute) AND no suite with regression > 0.05
- quant-specific: compare log-prob calibration drift; if calibration shift > 0.03, require recalibration/rewrite

maria_g: CANARY HOLDPOINTS AND ROLLOUT STAGES
- canary-1: 1% traffic, 2h observation, check for spike in 5xx, latency p95, error patterns. automatic rollback on 3x increase in 5xx or p95 > target*1.5
- canary-2: 10% traffic, 24h observation, manual signoff after quality dashboard review (owner + QA)
- gradual: 25% -> 50% -> 100% with monitoring thresholds and fallback to baseline model on anomalies

alex_t: love this. a couple quick asks: add a short checklist item for ``seeded-rerun`` (same rng seed) to verify deterministic quant artifacts, and call out exact CI job names so infra can wire alerts.

jamal.k: how many samples for the smoke prompt-suite? you said 500 for smoke earlier but smoke harness looks smaller. want to standardize: smoke=50, quick=500, full=5k?

maria_g: good catch - update: smoke=50 (fast dev), quick=500 (CI nightly), full=5k (regression/gate). will add seeded-rerun step.

eval-bot: CI job enqueued: `eval/quant-smoke/2045001234` -> status: queued. link: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/2045001234

eval-bot: last-run summary for baseline (run 2044009999): smoke avg semantic-match 0.842, latency p50 120ms, p95 310ms. baseline_score 0.882

jamal.k: for pass thresholds, can we replace absolute % with z-score for small sample suites? small n variance messes thresholds.

maria_g: yes, for suites with n<200 use z-score thresholding (z<-2 flagged) and require manual review before failing. will document formula in the checklist.

sre-bot: note: canary-1 at 1% traffic will still route to dedicated gpus; capacity alert if concurrent requests exceed 120 per GPU. recommend scheduling canary during low usage window.

alex_t: also add owner field to the canary message so on-call knows who to ping. maybe `owner-email` and `rollback-cmd` in the canary payload.

maria_g: ack. final action items: (1) I'll update the checklist file in repo (docs/onboard/holdpoints.md) with seeded-rerun + z-score rules + CI job names; (2) @alex_t to add canary payload schema to infra; (3) @jamal.k to run a dry run with current candidate after lunch and paste smoke output here.

jamal.k: will run at 13:30 PT and report back. :thumbsup:

alex_t: :thumbsup:

maria_g: thanks all — if no objections I'll mark this as the canonical quick-gate for new with quant attempts. react :white_check_mark: to approve.
